blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Compensation is the money you receive for your work. It has two main parts: the salary and the benefits.

The salary is the money. The benefits are extra things. Benefits can be health insurance, meal vouchers, a pension plan and more.

Every month, HR sends a pay slip. The pay slip shows how much you earn and the taxes. It is important to read and understand your pay slip.

items.q: What are the two main parts of compensation?
options: The taxes and the pay slip
The health insurance and the pension
The salary and the meal voucher
items.why: "It has two main parts: the salary and the benefits."

items.q: What does the pay slip show?
options: How much you earn and the taxes
items.why: "The pay slip shows how much you earn and the taxes."

items.q: The text says a meal voucher is…
items.why: Inferência: o texto lista o vale-refeição entre os benefícios ("Benefits can be… meal vouchers…").

items.q: The text suggests that reading your pay slip is…
items.why: Inferência: "It is important to read and understand your pay slip."

items.q: Who sends the pay slip every month?
items.why: "Every month, HR sends a pay slip."

blocks.instruction: Ouça Charlotte ajudando Lucas com o primeiro holerite dele. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi Lucas! This is your first pay slip, so let me help you. It looks difficult, but it is easy.

Look here at the top. This is your gross salary. Gross means before taxes. It is the full money.

Now look down here. This is the tax. The tax is the money the government takes. So your net salary is smaller than your gross salary. Net means after taxes. This is the money you receive in your bank account.

And here you can see your benefits. Czarnikow gives you health insurance, a meal voucher and a pension plan. These are extra. They are not in your salary, but they are part of your compensation.

Your salary is paid on the last day of every month. So you receive your money at the end of the month.

Do you have questions? You can always ask me or HR. It is good to read and understand your pay slip.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Charlotte helping Lucas with?
items.why: "This is your first pay slip, so let me help you."

items.q: What does "gross" mean?
items.why: "Gross means before taxes."

items.q: When is the salary paid?
options: On the last day of every month
In the middle of the month
On the first day of the month
items.why: "Your salary is paid on the last day of every month."

items.q: Why is the net salary smaller than the gross salary?
options: Because the company keeps some money
Because the government takes the tax
Because the bank charges a fee
items.why: Inferência: "The tax is the money the government takes. So your net salary is smaller."

items.q: From what Charlotte says, the benefits are…
options: extra, and part of the compensation
items.why: Inferência: "These are extra… but they are part of your compensation."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "My salary is paid every month." A salary is…
options: the tax on the pay slip
the money you receive for your work
items.why: Salary = salário, o dinheiro que você recebe pelo trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Health insurance and meal vouchers are ___."
items.why: Benefits = benefícios; plano de saúde e vale-refeição são exemplos.

items.q: "The tax is on my pay slip." A tax is…
options: money the government takes from your salary
items.why: Tax = imposto, o dinheiro que o governo tira do salário.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "How much do I ___ after taxes?"
items.why: To earn = ganhar; "how much do I earn" = quanto eu ganho.

items.q: "My gross salary is bigger than my net salary." Gross means…
items.why: Gross = bruto (antes dos impostos); net = líquido (depois).

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem quando falamos de salário e benefícios no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Charlotte, can you help me out with my pay slip?" To help someone out means to…
items.why: Help out = dar uma ajuda, ajudar com algo.

items.q: "HR will sign off on your benefits this week." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "The company will set up your pension plan." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = montar, criar, deixar pronto para funcionar.

items.q: "My salary is paid at the end of the month, so I have to wait for it." To wait for means to…
items.why: Wait for = esperar por algo.

items.q: "If a number is wrong, HR will sort it out." To sort something out means to…
items.why: Sort out = resolver, arrumar um problema.
